recommended_implementation.worker: one multiprocessing spawn worker per external attempt
recommended_implementation.parent_action: start worker, join(30), inspect result queue
recommended_implementation.timeout_action: if worker remains alive, terminate/kill, join, mark TIMEOUT
recommended_implementation.cleanup: remove IPC/temp state and do not checkpoint partial output

explicitly_not_sufficient: thread join timeout with a still-running network call
future.cancel() after the request has entered blocking I/O
soft elapsed-time logging without terminating the worker
attempt_accounting: A timed-out worker consumes the attempt budget; it may retry once under retry_contract.json.
